input.quote: 5.2 The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property ownership provision. HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site (§1.1–1.3) and the Company supplies all Content (§2.1), but nothing states who owns the Site, the code and other work product developed for us, or the customer/user data generated through the Site. Section 5.2 gives us only artistic and editorial control, §6.1 is a limited trademark licence from us to HDI, and §8 treats Content and user information only as confidential — none of these confers ownership or a licence back. That leaves our deliverables and customer data unallocated, short of both the preferred and fallback positions.

proposal.summary: Add an ownership clause: Company owns Content, the Site and deliverables (HDI assigns), HDI keeps pre-existing platform with licence back, Company owns Site customer data, no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on who owns the Site, the deliverables developed for us and the customer data generated through the Site, so we have added a standard ownership section: we own the Content and the work product HDI creates for us, HDI keeps its pre-existing platform and tools and licenses back anything embedded in the Site, and we own Site customer data with no joint ownership. If HDI needs to retain ownership of generic hosting tools it develops, we can work from that provided we keep a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to use and modify the Site.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership; Company Data. As between the Parties, the Company shall own all right, title and interest in and to (i) the Content, the Marks and all other materials furnished by the Company, and (ii) the Site, including its design, look and feel, code and other deliverables and work product created by or for HDI under this Agreement, and HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest in and to the foregoing. HDI shall retain ownership of its pre-existing software, hosting platform, administration tools and general know-how, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable license to use, modify and exploit any such HDI materials incorporated in or necessary to use the Site and such deliverables. As between the Parties, the Company shall own all right, title and interest in and to all data collected from or about users and customers of the Site relating to Deerskin Products, including order and customer e-mail list data ("Company Data"), which HDI may use solely to perform its obligations under this Agreement. Nothing in this Agreement shall create any joint ownership of intellectual property.
